title: Ideality adapter behavior contract (v1)
description: Declarative expectations for one catalog adapter's observable compiled behavior. catalog:check compiles the manifest with the runtime compiler and fails on any drift; contracts are data only and never execute the tool.

contractVersion.description: Contract format version. Only 1 is supported.

tool.description: Catalog ID of the adapter this contract locks; must match catalog/<tool>.jsonc and this file's name.

detection.description: Expected executable probe order: the primary executable followed by every alternative, deduplicated.

auth.description: Expected full auth argv per action, starting with the executable (e.g. ["gh", "auth", "login"]). Required exactly when the manifest declares auth, covering the same actions.

profiles.description: Named identity shapes with the exact compiled default profile expected for each.

redactions.description: Exact set of profile env vars that carry secret material (non-literal sources or sensitive names) and therefore surface redacted.

argv.description: Full expected argv, never interpreted by a shell.

case.description: Unique name for this identity shape, e.g. 'default' or 'with-ssh-key'.

identity.description: Identity fields provided to the compiler for this case; omit for an identity without keys.

env.description: Expected compiled profile env, compared verbatim (value sources included). Omitted means empty.

args.description: Expected compiled profile argv entries in order. Omitted means empty.
